# DevSandbox

> Interactive developer sandbox at https://gateaway.cloud for studying FastAPI event-loop starvation, PostgreSQL shared_buffers and EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), and Kubernetes blue/green traffic shifting through browser simulators backed by live HTTP probes.

DevSandbox is a React 18 + TypeScript single-page application served from the apex domain `gateaway.cloud`. It provides three interactive trainers: Sync vs Async, PostgreSQL X-Ray, and Blue/Green CI/CD. The interface is available in English and Russian; the locale is stored in the browser and does not change the URL. Live probes are served by a FastAPI backend at `/api/v1/*` and run inside an isolated k3s `sandbox` namespace with a ResourceQuota.

## Documentation

- [DevSandbox home](https://gateaway.cloud/): Entry point with the interactive trainers, architecture decision matrix, and technical deep-dive article.
- [Architecture and isolation](https://gateaway.cloud/about): k3s namespace quotas, read-only PostgreSQL role, AST validation, and CLS=0 guarantees.
- [Contact and community](https://gateaway.cloud/contact): Email and GitHub contacts for probe proposals and bug reports.
- [Privacy policy](https://gateaway.cloud/privacy-policy): Local telemetry storage and guest session handling.
- [Terms of service](https://gateaway.cloud/terms-of-service): Acceptable use of the sandbox and its live probes.

## Trainers

- [Sync vs Async skill](https://gateaway.cloud/skills/sync-async.md): How the simulator and live I/O benchmark demonstrate event-loop blocking in `async def`.
- [PostgreSQL X-Ray skill](https://gateaway.cloud/skills/pg-xray.md): How TABLESAMPLE, column projection, and scan strategies affect buffer reads.
- [Blue/Green CI/CD skill](https://gateaway.cloud/skills/blue-green.md): How weighted HTTPRoute shifts, canaries, and rollback scenarios avoid dropped packets.
